p: carried away to Babylon for their: Until now he has described their genealogies before they went into captivity, and now he describes their history after their return.
Nethinims: Meaning, the Gibeonites, who served in the temple, read Jos 9:23.
ruler of the house of God: That is, he was the high priest.
work of the service of the: To serve in the temple, every one according to his office.
king's gate eastward: So called because the king came into the temple by it, and not the common people.
tabernacle: Their charge was that no one should enter those places, which were only appointed for the priests to minister in.
seven days from time to time: They served weekly, as in Ex 29:30.
flour: Of which the meat offering was made, Le 2:8.
were free: But were continually occupied in singing praises to God.
Jarah: Who was also called Jehoiada, 1Ch 8:36.
